newsitem.title: CHINA: China's auto imports fall 41.7 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China's auto imports fall 41.7 percent in 1996.

text.p: China's automobile imports fell 41.7 percent in 1996 compared with the previous year to a total of 92,000, the Market Daily said on Friday.
One reason for the fall in imports was due to large numbers of cars imported from eastern Europe under a now-defunct barter trade system, it said but gave no further details.
While Japanese customs figures showed 37,400 cars exported to China, Chinese customs showed imports of 13,900, a sign indication that most imports had entered illegally, it said.
Imports also fell due to lower prices for domestically made automobiles, and on large stockpiles accumulated in recent years, it said but gave no details.
